scientific_integrity: A pathwise orbit identity is proved, and an exact enumerator supplements but does not replace the proof. Non-Gaussian skew boundary is explicit.
scientific_limitations: A law-invariant maximum/position covariance for square-integrable cyclic zero-sum bridges; the stronger joint reflection requires negated reversal. Brownian special cases are not claimed novel. Priority relative to inaccessible older literature remains uncertain.
title: Cyclic-bridge maximum–position duality without sign symmetry
